item.title: How Mobility Data Can Help Cities Prepare for Large Public Events
item.description: Turkey’s Republic Day celebrations attract large public gatherings across the country, including in Istanbul. For city planners, an event of this scale raises practical questions: When do visits to different parts of the city begin to increase?

item.title: Assessing Traffic Congestion and Accessibility to Jobs Using Waze for Cities and Mapbox Data
item.description: Traffic congestion and suburbanization are becoming increasingly significant factors affecting urban mobility and limiting access to jobs and opportunities in most mid-sized cities worldwide.
